name: a1-deploy-handover-2026-08-23
title: A1 deployed, hostssh API-root gate trap, remaining A1 work
description: A1 deployed, hostssh API-root gate trap, remaining A1 work
body:
A1 agent-inbox is DEPLOYED (git push hostssh main, 2026-08-23) but not done.

What landed: two commits. First bundled A1 with the Phase A backlog (hosted mailbox receiving, abuse screening, privacy endpoints, health probes, SSRF/MIME hardening, RBAC, maillog bridge, marketing honesty pass) as one batch because files interleaved. Second: API GET / JSON descriptor (not 302 to marketing).

Rebase: origin/main lint-fix escaped apostrophes on OLD copy of five marketing pages (dedicated-IP add-on, seed-list tests, 5k free tier). Honesty pass already rewrote that. All 18 hunks resolved for honesty pass. lint clean, typecheck 11/11, gates 21/21.

Deploy trap: API / used to 302 to electronicmailservices.com. hostssh blue-green asset gate followed it, then resolved /_next/* against the API container → five 404s, rollback, set -e so web/workers never deployed. Would block EVERY future deploy. Live site was fine. Fix is in-repo JSON at /. Marketing sub-path redirects and no-second-copy-of-marketing rule untouched. After fix: "assets skipped — / is application, not a page."

Live: api.electronicmailservices.com/ JSON; /readyz Postgres+Redis green (migration 0019); /inboxes and /inboxes/domains 401 unauth; electronicmailservices.com 200.

Open: /readyz degraded — 67 failed send-queue jobs, static, zero waiting, leftover stub-mode. Clear them.

A1 remaining: MX/SPF/DKIM on shared domains (inbox.electronicmailservices.com MX maybe live since June), e2e dogfood, dev docs, SDK methods.
